chunks.title: Landmark Precedents in Corporate & Commercial Law
chunks.content: # Landmark Precedents in Corporate & Commercial Law

chunks.title: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd. v. Cyrus Investments Pvt. Ltd., (2021) 9 SCC 449
chunks.content:
### Tata Consultancy Services Ltd. v. Cyrus Investments Pvt. Ltd., (2021) 9 SCC 449
**Bench & Court:** Supreme Court of India (S.A. Bobde, CJI)
**Core Holding:** Clarified the high threshold for establishing oppression and mismanagement under Sections 241/242 of Companies Act. Removal of a Director by majority shareholders per Articles of Association does not automatically amount to oppression unless lack of probity or fraud is demonstrated.

chunks.title: Kailash Nath Associates v. DDA, (2015) 4 SCC 136
chunks.content:
### Kailash Nath Associates v. DDA, (2015) 4 SCC 136
**Bench & Court:** Supreme Court of India (R.F. Nariman, J.)
**Core Holding:** Section 74 of the Contract Act requires proof of actual damage or loss before earnest money or liquidated damages can be forfeited, unless it is impossible to prove damages.

chunks.title: NCLT Practice & Commercial Court Filing
chunks.content:
### NCLT Practice & Commercial Court Filing
1. **Commercial Courts Act 2015:** Mandatory pre-institution mediation under Section 12A for commercial suits not seeking urgent interim relief.
2. **Standard of Board Decisions:** Business Judgment Rule protects bona fide commercial decisions taken by board of directors with reasonable care.

chunks.title: Companies Act, 2013
chunks.content:
### Companies Act, 2013
- **Section 166:** Fiduciary duties of directors to act in good faith to promote the objects of the company for the benefit of members and avoid conflicts of interest.
- **Section 241 & 242:** Application to NCLT for relief in cases of oppression of minority shareholders and mismanagement.
- **Section 135:** Mandatory Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) compliance for qualifying companies.

chunks.title: Indian Contract Act, 1872
chunks.content:
### Indian Contract Act, 1872
- **Section 10:** Essential elements of valid contracts (free consent, competent parties, lawful consideration, lawful object).
- **Section 73:** Compensation for loss or damage caused by breach of contract (naturally arising in the usual course or known to parties).
- **Section 74:** Liquidated damages and penalty clauses (reasonable compensation not exceeding the amount named).
